# Clarity ADHD

Clarity ADHD is a cash-pay adult ADHD telehealth practice in Washington State, founded by Lucas Craft, MMS, PA-C, a board-certified physician assistant focused on adult ADHD specialty care.

Clarity ADHD does not bill insurance. Superbills are available for possible out-of-network reimbursement. Care is for adults 18 and older who are physically located in Washington State at the time of the visit.

The Adult ADHD Assessment and Optimization program costs $1,099, or 3 or 4 monthly payments at no additional cost. The program is 5 visits over about 5 weeks. The last appointment is week 5. After the last visit there is a 2-week extended-release (XR) medication trial, so the full path is about 7 weeks from the first appointment through the XR trial. It is not a 6-week program.

Objective testing uses remote QbCheck, completed from home and interpreted with the clinical history and other findings.

Stimulant medications are currently permitted via telehealth under federal and Washington rules when applicable requirements are met. No end date is named here; this page will be updated if the rules change.

Three medication trials are typical during the program. They are the usual path, not an obligatory requirement for every patient.

Hours: Monday 12:00 PM–1:00 PM; Tuesday, Saturday, and Sunday 9:30 AM–6:00 PM; Wednesday–Friday closed. Phone: (360) 453-7663.
